status: AI-drafted. No fiducial or lead dimension is drawn until a review ledger entry covers it.

fiducial_set.method: Placed by written rules on the average template head, by code and not by a person feeling a skull. The average blurs skin landmarks and the skin does not show the inion, so these are estimates for a person to review.

evidence.rationale: Landmarks were found by rule on the template head surface; no person located them.

source_ref.quote: It is the skin of an average head, not of a person.

electrode_layouts.name: International 10-20 system: 19 scalp positions, Fpz and Oz
electrode_layouts.construction: Each position sits at a share of the measured length of an arc over the scalp between landmarks, in the order the system defines.

evidence.rationale: Positions are shares of arcs measured on the template head surface, not on a person.

source_ref.quote: It is the skin of an average head, not of a person.

facts.statement: In one study of 16 adults, the brain location under a given scalp electrode varied between people with a standard deviation of 4.6, 7.1 and 7.8 mm in x, y and z. The study used the 10-10 system and Talairach coordinates, not this template.
facts.citation: Koessler L, Maillard L, Benhadid A, Vignal JP, Felblinger J, Vespignani H, Braun M. Automated cortical projection of EEG sensors: anatomical correlation via the international 10-10 system. NeuroImage 2009;46:64-72. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2009.02.006
facts.quote: a grand standard deviation of 4.6 mm in x, 7.1 mm in y and 7.8 mm in z
